sources.title: Current privacy boundaries

sources.finding: One desktop preference controls activation analytics, automatic error reports and daily per-tool task/terminal counts. Off stops counts and discards pending uploads. sources.finding: The release notes say the analytics sharing setting also controls terminal-failure diagnostics and clears pending diagnostics when disabled. The passage does not specify whether that setting is an interface control or configuration-only.
